scope: Read-only fixed Updates candidate review; no Backend re-audit or repeated stable tests.
reviewed: All valid lightweight context observations are emitted before sequential completion-detail work; no extra dispatch, parallel requests, cache or Task identity is introduced.
Original Account/Actor/Trip/Batch binding and Account-generation/current-view checks remain; each queued detail additionally revalidates the owning Account request context.
A failed detail cannot erase a valid Task status; Account/generation invalidation stops queued work and discards the final observation map.
Projection still uses main tripPrior and exact current Account/Trip Batch scope; optional filename/text/submission metadata is derived only from that same accepted Batch.
Stable universal-import:Batch event identity, deduplication, Task/receipt event update time and ordering remain unchanged. Submission time is separate display metadata.
Filename is shown only for one Source with a real nonblank retained filename; TEXT fallback uses an existing localized submitted-text label, and missing/multiple sources do not invent a filename.
UI uses existing localization/date helpers and canonical controls; query filtering includes optional metadata while legacy cards without new fields continue rendering.
No shared navigation, session, assignedTrip DTO, schema, authority, Source qualification or Provider changes are included.

validationReused.strictTypes: Implementing agent final check remains separate; no assertion made by this reviewer

limitations: No actual Native/Hosted E2E, main merge or device operation performed here.
Context GETs remain sequential; this change prevents detail reads from blocking later statuses but does not promise a network latency SLA.
